O3_label: prior-blind deletion control (capacity claim dropped; see A3)

eshift.endpoint: survival fraction over the nine checkpoints (amendment A4)

analysis.primary_estimator: family-fixed-effects linear probability model of RETAINED at k=10 on within-family-centred Bradley-Terry surprise x operator, with token-length and digit-format nuisance covariates
analysis.main_chain_inference: two-way crossed cluster bootstrap over families and chain x seed blocks, blocks carrying all paired operators
analysis.eshift_inference: family bootstrap with arm-paired seed blocks resampled within family (trajectories are nested within families there)
analysis.C1_primary_population: eligible-only (Half-A screen); ITT reported as sensitivity; C1 declared inconclusive if they disagree in direction
